title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘calls for the creation of a European democracy assessment that enables the early detection of signs of authoritarian tendencies, as well as a toolbox for action centred on democracy support and countering authoritarian narratives, particularly in the light of the regrettable closure of the US Agency for International Development (USAID) operations;’
